words: Second paw audit after the reconstruction pass (B-dp38) came out worse than brushing: small multi-digit crops reconstruct as mush with invented nail sleeves. What did work on this creature for precise organic tubes: the tail and the horns, built as swept tubes with a radius profile measured from the clay (tail passed first try). Outcome: change the method again: each digit is a swept tube along its own centerline with a measured radius profile (knuckle bulges as radius maxima, a rounded pad underneath, a rounded tip), the four digits and a metatarsal or metacarpal pad unioned by a local voxel remesh and lightly smoothed, grafted below 65 mm; start from the pass 3 paws on the merged file. Reconstruction stays the rule for large soft volumes; rule 12 amended to say so.
